accepted.s: With reference to the Economic Survey 2025-26, which one of the following statements is correct?
o: Yields of major crops remained unchanged nationally and globally.
Yields of major crops declined nationally but exceeded global averages.
Yields of major crops rose globally but declined nationally.
Yields of major crops rose nationally but remained below global averages.
accepted.x: The Economic Survey 2025-26 reported that yields of major crops increased nationally, but they remained below global averages.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the direction of change from the comparison with the global average.
accepted.sec: Crop productivity in AP vs national average

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding food-grain and paddy area in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Kharif food-grain area increased from 18.13 lakh hectares in 2023-24 to 20.36 lakh hectares in 2024-25.
2. Rabi food-grain area increased from 15.11 lakh hectares to 17.15 lakh hectares during the same period.
3. Paddy area in Rabi 2024-25 was 6.93 lakh hectares.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Kharif food-grain area was 20.36 lakh hectares, Rabi food-grain area was 17.15 lakh hectares and Rabi paddy area was 6.93 lakh hectares in 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical row independently before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Kharif vs rabi area trends

accepted.s: The increase in food-grain area in Andhra Pradesh during 2024-25 was associated with which one of the following combinations?
o: 16.5% increase in area and 11.7% rainfall deficit
12.85% increase in area and 11.7% rainfall surplus
11.7% increase in area and 12.85% rainfall surplus
12.85% decrease in area and 16.5% rainfall surplus
accepted.x: The 2024-25 rise in food-grain area was 12.85%, following an 11.7% rainfall surplus. The preceding year had recorded a 16.5% rainfall deficit.
accepted.tq: Separate the area percentage from the rainfall percentage and avoid reversing the two figures.
accepted.sec: Kharif vs rabi area trends

accepted.s: In the Kharif 2026 season, the sowing area recorded by 19 August was approximately what percentage of the normal area?
accepted.x: By 19 August, 18.9 lakh hectares had been sown against the normal 30.84 lakh hectares, or approximately 61%.
accepted.tq: Match the reported actual-to-normal area ratio with the percentage options.
accepted.sec: Kharif vs rabi area trends

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the Kharif 2026 crop-wise sowing position as a percentage of normal area?
accepted.x: The reported percentages were groundnut 34%, paddy 62%, maize 61%, pulses 70% and cotton 75% of normal area.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure crop-percentage pair and verify the remaining pairs before choosing the code.
accepted.sec: Kharif vs rabi area trends

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Kharif 2026 in Andhra Pradesh:
1. All 28 districts were in a rainfall-deficit condition.
2. Twenty-five districts were deficit and three were classified as large-deficit districts.
3. The sowing position was approximately 61% of the normal area by 19 August.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Kharif 2026 was described as a drought season, with all 28 districts in deficit, 25 deficit and 3 large-deficit, and sowing at about 61% of normal by 19 August.
accepted.tq: Test the district count, its classification and the area figure as three separate statements.
accepted.sec: Kharif vs rabi area trends

accepted.s: The current shift in the cropping pattern of Andhra Pradesh is primarily towards:
o: Only paddy and other food grains
accepted.x: The cropping pattern is shifting towards fruits, vegetables, flowers and spices because of their profitability and export potential.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the emerging diversification pattern from the traditional crop groups.
accepted.sec: Cropping pattern shifts - aquaculture, commercial crops

accepted.s:
Which of the following factors are attributed to diversification of agriculture in Andhra Pradesh?
1. Market demand
2. Access to irrigation
3. Government policy
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Market demand, irrigation access and policy are all identified as factors driving agricultural diversification in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: When all listed causal factors are directly relevant, test whether the complete combination is the key.
accepted.sec: Cropping pattern shifts - aquaculture, commercial crops

accepted.s: The conversion of paddy land into aquaculture in Andhra Pradesh has made which area the State's aquaculture hub?
accepted.x: Paddy land in the Godavari delta is being converted to aquaculture, making the delta the State's aquaculture hub.
accepted.tq: Apply the location-based trap by matching the activity with its specifically identified region.
accepted.sec: Cropping pattern shifts - aquaculture, commercial crops

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the 11 crops targeted for productivity improvement under the 17 growth engines of Swarna Andhra @2047?
accepted.x: The 11 crops include paddy, maize, jowar, bajra, ragi, redgram, blackgram, bengalgram, groundnut, sunflower and sesamum. Sugarcane is not included in this specified list.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the explicitly enumerated crop list.
accepted.sec: Cropping pattern shifts - aquaculture, commercial crops

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Scheme)
a. YSR Jala Kala
b. YSR Rythu Bharosa
c. Rythu Bazars
 d. Jala Yagnam

List-II (Domain)
i. Investment support
 ii. Free borewells for farmers
 iii. Farmer-to-consumer sales
 iv. Irrigation through 52 major and medium projects

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: YSR Jala Kala provides free borewells; YSR Rythu Bharosa provides investment support; Rythu Bazars facilitate farmer-to-consumer sales; and Jala Yagnam concerns irrigation projects.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure scheme-domain pair and eliminate codes that disturb the remaining relationships.
accepted.sec: AP scheme → domain matching

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Jala Yagnam — Interest subvention on crop loans
accepted.x: Panta Sanjeevani refers to the construction of farm ponds. GAP Polambadi concerns farmer field schools and Ind.GAP certification, while Jala Yagnam concerns irrigation projects.
accepted.tq: Separate similarly agriculture-related schemes by identifying their precise domain rather than their broad sector.
accepted.sec: AP scheme → domain matching

accepted.s: Under Vaddi Leni Runalu or Pavala Vaddi, interest subvention on crop loans is provided as follows:
o: 1% up to ₹1 lakh and 4% for ₹1 lakh to ₹3 lakh
1% on all crop loans up to ₹3 lakh
4% up to ₹3 lakh and 1% above ₹3 lakh
4% up to ₹1 lakh and 1% for ₹1 lakh to ₹3 lakh
accepted.x: The scheme provides 4% interest subvention up to ₹1 lakh and 1% for the loan amount from ₹1 lakh to ₹3 lakh.
accepted.tq: Keep the two loan slabs and their respective rates in the correct order.
accepted.sec: AP scheme → domain matching

accepted.s: Panta Sanjeevani, in the context of Andhra Pradesh agriculture, refers to:
o: Distribution of free borewells to every farmer
Construction of farm ponds for rainwater harvesting and protective irrigation
Interest-free crop loans up to ₹3 lakh
Direct procurement of horticultural produce from farmers
accepted.x: Panta Sanjeevani means construction of farm ponds. It is a rainwater-harvesting measure for protective irrigation, with farm ponds dug through convergence with MGNREGS.
accepted.tq: Identify the practical component of the scheme from the agricultural problem it addresses.
accepted.sec: Panta Sanjeevani - meaning, component, initial outlay

accepted.s: Farm ponds under Panta Sanjeevani were dug through convergence with:
accepted.x: Farm ponds under Panta Sanjeevani were dug through convergence with the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme.
accepted.tq: Use the implementing-convergence relationship to distinguish the employment programme from insurance and certification schemes.
accepted.sec: Panta Sanjeevani - meaning, component, initial outlay

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the free crop insurance arrangement in Andhra Pradesh during 2019-24?
o: The Centre paid the whole premium and only horticultural crops were covered.
The State and Centre shared the premium equally and enrolment was compulsory for all farmers.
The State paid the whole premium and CCRC holders were covered.
The farmer paid the entire actuarial premium and only loanee farmers were covered.
accepted.x: Under Dr YSR Free Crop Insurance during 2019-24, the State paid the entire premium and CCRC holders were covered.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the earlier free-insurance model from the subsequent voluntary premium-sharing model.
accepted.sec: Crop insurance in AP - free crop insurance, PMFBY, the switch

accepted.s: From Rabi 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh returned to which arrangement for crop insurance?
o: Voluntary enrolment under MNAIS with the Centre paying the full premium
Universal insurance under Ind.GAP with FPOs paying the premium
Compulsory enrolment under NAIS with the State paying the full premium
Voluntary enrolment under PMFBY/RWBCIS with the farmer paying a fixed share and the State and Centre sharing the balance equally
accepted.x: From Rabi 2024-25, enrolment became voluntary under PMFBY/RWBCIS. Farmers pay a small fixed share of the actuarial premium, while the State and Centre equally share the remainder.
accepted.tq: Compare the institutional arrangement, enrolment condition and premium-sharing formula in one option.
accepted.sec: Crop insurance in AP - free crop insurance, PMFBY, the switch

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding PMFBY is/are correct?
1. PMFBY was introduced in 2016.
2. It replaced NAIS and MNAIS.
3. It became voluntary for all farmers from Kharif 2020.
4. It is a Central Sector scheme.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: PMFBY was introduced in 2016, replaced NAIS and MNAIS, became voluntary for all farmers from Kharif 2020, and is a Central Sector scheme.
accepted.tq: Test the scheme's year, predecessor schemes, enrolment rule and administrative classification separately.
accepted.sec: Crop insurance in AP - free crop insurance, PMFBY, the switch

accepted.s: Under PMFBY, the farmer's premium share is correctly stated as:
o: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops
1.5% for Kharif, 2% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial crops
5% for Kharif, 2% for Rabi, and 1.5% for horticultural crops
2% for all crops in every season
accepted.x: The farmer premium under PMFBY is 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversing the Kharif and Rabi rates and retain the separate commercial-crop rate.
accepted.sec: Crop insurance in AP - free crop insurance, PMFBY, the switch

accepted.s: The pilot project for direct benefit transfer of the agricultural power subsidy in Andhra Pradesh was undertaken in:
accepted.x: Srikakulam district was selected for the 2020 pilot involving smart meters on farm pump-sets and direct credit of subsidy to farmers' accounts.
accepted.tq: Use the district-specific location clue to distinguish the pilot site from other agricultural districts.
accepted.sec: DBT of free agricultural power subsidy - pilot district, smart meters

accepted.s: In the agricultural power subsidy DBT pilot in Andhra Pradesh, smart meters were installed on:
accepted.x: Smart meters were installed on farm pump-sets, and the subsidy was credited to farmers' accounts for payment to the distribution company.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact beneficiary asset rather than the broader electricity network.
accepted.sec: DBT of free agricultural power subsidy - pilot district, smart meters

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the stated long-term energy objective for agricultural pump-sets in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Restriction of agricultural power supply to Rabi season
Replacement of all pump-sets by diesel units
accepted.x: The State aims to achieve 100% renewable energy for agricultural pump-sets.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise policy target and reject options that reverse or narrow its objective.
accepted.sec: DBT of free agricultural power subsidy - pilot district, smart meters

accepted.s: GAP Polambadi is associated with:
o: Farmer Field Schools, Good Agricultural Practices and Ind.GAP certification
Crop insurance enrolment and premium collection
Construction of major and medium irrigation projects
accepted.x: Polambadi means Farmer Field Schools. GAP Polambadi teaches Good Agricultural Practices, aims to reduce chemical pesticide use and is linked to Ind.GAP certification for better prices for FPOs.
accepted.tq: Match the extension activity with its training, certification and pesticide-reduction functions.
accepted.sec: Department publications and extension - magazine, Polambadi

accepted.s: The agricultural and allied-sector strategy under APSES 2024-25 targets what growth over five years?
accepted.x: The strategy targets 30% growth in agriculture and allied sectors over five years, delivered through 17 growth engines.
accepted.tq: Keep the target percentage and the number of delivery mechanisms together while rejecting swapped figures.
